messages:
lina: spinning up a narrow probe for model v6-alpha-int4 on 0.8% traffic, 12h window. goal: check fidelity on short-context convo and code-edit prompts.
devin: nice. are we using the composite gate or single-metric thresholds?
lina: composite. score = 0.5*MRR_norm + 0.3*(1 - halluc_rate_norm) + 0.2*stability_norm. baseline = v5.3-fp16. fallback if composite drops >2.0 absolute points for 3 consecutive 10m windows.
hao: let's also watch KL_divergence between token distributions. if KL > 0.12 sustained 20m AND hallucination_up > 2.5% -> immediate rollback. KL catches subtle token-shift we missed before.
devin: good call. add a distinct quick-fail: p99 latency + error spikes. if p99 increases >200ms AND errors >0.2% for 15m -> roll back.
rollout-bot: probe started (id=GAMMA-1717). logging to /probes/gamma/v6-alpha-int4/1717779876. Will announce gate events.
lina: also curious about kv-eviction rate. quant path bumped memory pressure in staging; set a soft alert: eviction_rate_up > 5% triggers reduced batch size, not immediate rollback.
hao: for the statistical gate, because traffic small, use Bayesian credible interval instead of frequentist p-values. require 95% posterior prob that composite_metric > control - 1.5% to pass.
devin: implementation detail: experiment config will include `auto_fallback_policy: ["composite_drop", "kl_spike", "latency_error"]` and `remediate_actions: {kl_spike: "scale-down-quant", composite_drop: "reroute-traffic-50%"}`. (will push config in PR)
lina: can we shadow-route low-confidence outputs to eval-bucket instead of full traffic? threshold: output_entropy < 0.9 nats -> shadow. want to avoid low-entropy lockstep skewing MRR.
eval-bot: rolling eval hooks enabled: per-slice deltas, token-shift histogram, heatmap of prefix mismatches. will post hourly summaries to this thread.
devin: timeline: 12h probe, extend to 48h if clean. owners: lina (oncall), hao (eval signal), devin (runtime knobs). watch for rollout-bot alerts. :eyes:
lina: ok starting now. small ask: please be ready to ack any rollback alerts so rollout-bot can proceed with auto-fallback window.
